name: TCS-1205
summary: TCS 1205 is a GABAA receptor positive allosteric modulator of the tryptamine family. It is a benzodiazepine site agonist selective for certain subunits.

pharmacology.text: TCS 1205 acts at the benzodiazepine binding site, it is selective for the α1 and α2 subunits of the GABAA receptor. In vivo, it has anxiolytic effects but no sedative effects.
